contract.structural_score_basis: 🔴 CUT 6.0 → 4.0 on 2026-09-22. The 6.0 enumerated the TIMELOCK's roles and treated that as the system's power set. It is not: FOUR UNDELAYED PATHS sit beside the 72h delay. The sharpest is updatePriceOracle(address), unvalidated and undelayed, at THREE keys on every pool and at ONE key — the deployer EOA 0xa1d0027ca4c0cb79f9403d06a29470abc7b0a468 — on the WBTC pool carrying 89.7% of all debt. ⚠️ THE DELAY PROTECTS THE CODE AND NOT THE MARKS: the oracle decides what liquidates and whether redemption opens, so changing what the code READS is instant while changing the code takes three days. ✅ What survives: the upgrade path genuinely is a 6-of-9 Safe behind 72h with no bypass, EXECUTOR includes 0x0 so execution cannot be blocked, and updateDelay is reachable only through the timelock itself. Anchor: level with reusd-re 4.0 ("the delay protects the code and not the supply"); below yzusd 4.5, which has no independent veto but NO SINGLE-KEY PATH.
